jobs.occupation: Social Media & Influencer Specialist for PlayStation, Nordisk Interactive
jobs.description:
Role title: Brand Engagement & Community Specialist

Contract: Fixed-term maternity cover

Contract period: 1st of January 2027 – 1st of February 2028

Location: Nordisk Interactive, Valby, Copenhagen

Working model: Hybrid

Do you love gaming, social media and creator culture - and do you know how to make a global brand feel local?

We are looking for a Brand Engagement & Community Specialist for Denmark to join PlayStation Nordic as a fixed-term maternity cover from 1st January 2027 to 1st of February 2028.

This role sits in our Marketing team and is all about bringing PlayStation closer to players every day through social media, influencer collaborations, local content and community management.

This is a hands-on role. You will not just sit in meetings talking about campaigns. You will help make them happen.

You will work closely with our Leads across social media, PR, influencers, brand partnerships, sponsorships and campaigns - and you will be one of the people making sure PlayStation shows up in a way that feels relevant, local and real.

**What you'll be doing

**Social media, content and community

You will help run PlayStation’s Danish social channels day to day. That means planning, publishing, adapting content, engaging with the community and making sure our tone feels right for our Danish audience.

You will work with global assets, Danish ideas and real-time opportunities across channels like Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and other relevant platforms.

In practice, this means:

• Adapting global PlayStation content so it works in Danish language, tone and context

• Supporting the local social media calendar

• Publishing and scheduling content (in collaboration with student assistant)

• Managing community engagement and comments

• Spotting local trends and moments we can react to

• Supporting live coverage around events, campaigns and sponsorships

• Making sure our content feels like PlayStation, but also like it belongs locally

You will also collaborate with the Danish student assistant on relevant tasks such as translations, content adaptations and community work.

Influencers and creators

Creators are a big part of how we bring PlayStation to life in the Nordics. You will support our local influencer work, from finding the right profiles to briefing, seeding and following up on content.

You will work closely with our PR & Influencer Lead, but you will also be expected to take ownership of the day-to-day coordination in the Danish market.

This includes:

• Building and maintaining relationships with Danish creators and PlayStation Playmakers

• Supporting influencer briefings, seedings and content follow-up

• Coordinating products, merchandise and hardware where relevant

• Tracking creator content and helping report on performance

• Making sure creators are properly briefed and aligned with PlayStation guidelines

Campaign and partnership support

You will be involved in some of the biggest PlayStation moments of the year. That can be major game launches, hardware pushes, UEFA sponsorship activations, retail collaborations, influencer events or local content ideas.

You will help turn strategy into actual execution.

That means:

• Supporting priority campaigns in the Danish market

• Contributing with local ideas and cultural input

• Helping execute brand partnership and sponsorship activations

• Supporting events, press moments and consumer activations

• Working in Monday.com to keep tasks, owners and deadlines clear

• Making sure local execution is on time and on brief

What we are looking for

We are looking for someone who is structured, curious and genuinely interested in gaming, social media and online communities.

You do not need to know everything from day one. But you do need to be proactive, willing to learn and comfortable working in a team where many things move at the same time.

You probably bring:

• Danish at native level, especially written Danish

• Strong English skills

• Good understanding of social media and creator culture

• A strong feel for what works in Denmark

• Good writing skills and attention to tone of voice

• Confidence in coordinating tasks and keeping projects moving

• Good attention to detail

• Ability to work with several stakeholders at once

• Interest in gaming, entertainment and online communities

• Experience with social media, influencer work, content production, communications or marketing

• Familiarity with tools like Monday.com, Upfluence or Emplifi is a plus, but not a requirement

Most importantly, you are someone people enjoy working with. We need someone who can take responsibility, communicate clearly and help make the team better.

What can you expect?

You will join a team that cares deeply about PlayStation, but also about doing good work together.

We are a Nordic team working across multiple markets, cultures and disciplines. Some days are structured. Some days are messy. That is part of the job. But you will be close to great campaigns, major game launches, creators, communities and some of the biggest entertainment moments of the year.

You will get responsibility, trust and room to contribute.

Application task

Please apply by using the "Apply Now". We do not receive applications via. e-mail.

As part of your application, we would like you to include a short video of max. 1 minute.

In the video, please answer this question in Danish:

_• Tell us about something you are proud of creating, improving or making happen.

_

This does not need to be professionally produced. We are not looking for editing skills or a polished influencer video. We are interested in how you think and how you communicate.

Our application system cannot receive video files, so please upload the video to YouTube, Vimeo or a similar platform and include the link in your application. An unlisted link is completely fine.

Application deadline is 22/10/2026.

About Nordisk Film

Nordisk Film was founded in 1906 in Valby, by entrepreneur Ole Olsen and is one of the world’s first film companies. They still have their headquarters in Valby, next to the world’s oldest film studio building and still own strong cultural values of passion and ambition.

In 1992, Nordisk Film became part of Egmont, a Nordic media group, and has within recent years seen high growth rates. In just over five years their revenues have increased with nearly 40%, and activities now span much wider than the film business that was the starting point. Today, Nordisk Film is among the leading entertainment companies in the Nordics involved in film and series production and distribution, cinemas, computer games, digital gifting and digital advertising.

For more than 20 years, and since the launch of Sony PlayStation, Nordisk Film Interactive has been the official distributor of the console and games in the Nordics and Baltics, and have made it one of Sony’s most successful markets.

jobs.occupation: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Build the team that builds Relesys. We’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead and develop one of our engineering teams.

You’ll be accountable for the team’s growth, performance and delivery, creating the conditions for engineers to do their best work and deliver meaningful customer and business outcomes sustainably. You’ll also help the team adopt AI effectively in software development and explore opportunities for AI-powered product innovation.

You turn strategy into a small set of clear priorities, make the trade-offs behind them visible, and create the planning and release rhythm that lets your area ship reliably. You stay accountable for architecture decisions, production health, security posture and technical debt - even when senior engineers are leading the actual design work - and you make sure delivery is backed by solid fundamentals: testing, observability, feature flags, and real incident learning.

This is an exciting and transformative time to join Relesys, as we have gone into a strategic partnership with the Private Equity fund, Copilot Capital, where the coming years will bring extensive growth and opportunities along the way. You get a unique opportunity to make a tremendous impact in taking your career, Relesys and our dear clients to the next level over the coming years - as we say, joining a scale-up at this stage is a rare opportunity that is “once in a lifetime”.

Your key responsibilities

• 
Lead and develop your people: Hold regular one-on-ones, provide timely and actionable feedback, and coach engineers through technical, professional and interpersonal challenges.

• 
Own career development and performance: Set clear expectations and individual development goals, conduct performance reviews, support progression and promotion decisions, and address underperformance early and constructively.

• 
Build a healthy, effective team: Foster trust, inclusion and accountability, resolve conflict, and actively support engagement, wellbeing and sustainable workloads.

• 
Hire and onboard engineers: Partner with People & Talent on hiring, plan team capabilities and capacity, and help new colleagues become effective contributors.

• 
Turn strategy into a small set of clear, prioritized outcomes for your area, and make the trade-offs behind them visible

• 
Create planning and release rhythms that make delivery more predictable, without relying on heavy process or overtime

• 
Own architecture trade-offs, production health, security posture and technical-debt decisions for your area - even when senior engineers lead the actual design

• 
Make sure delivery is backed by solid engineering fundamentals: testing, observability, feature flags, and real incident learning

• 
Use delivery, operational and customer evidence to continuously adjust plans and priorities

• 
Drive AI-assisted engineering: Help the team evaluate and adopt AI tools across development, testing, code review and documentation. Build practical skills, establish appropriate quality and data-handling practices, and assess their impact on delivery and maintainability.

• 
Enable AI product innovation: Partner with Product, Design and engineers to identify valuable AI use cases, run focused experiments, and take promising solutions into production with clear evaluation criteria for customer value, reliability, privacy and cost.

Who are you?

• 
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field

• 
+5 years of relevant experience as a software engineer or similar and ideally understanding of modern SaaS product development in an agile environment

• 
You have experience directly managing software engineers, including regular one-on-ones, coaching, career development, performance reviews and constructive handling of performance challenges.

• 
You have a track record of helping engineers grow and building teams with clear expectations, strong collaboration and sustainable delivery practices.

• 
You have practical experience applying AI tools to software development and can help a team experiment, assess results and adopt effective practices.

• 
You have hands-on technical depth and can credibly engage with architecture and infrastructure decisions, even if you're not writing production code day to day

• 
You have experience owning technical accountability for a team's area - architecture, production health, security, technical debt - while senior ICs lead the design work

• 
You know how to turn broad strategy into a handful of concrete priorities, and how to make trade-offs and their reasoning visible to a team

• 
You have experience improving delivery practices: testing discipline, observability, feature flags, incident learning

• 
You communicate clearly in written and spoken English

• 
You are based in or near London or Copenhagen

Furthermore, it would be great, but not required, if you:

• 
Are familiar with DORA metrics and how to work with them

• 
Have experience with observability tooling

• 
Come from an SRE background and have operated SLOs and error budgets in production

• 
Have led an engineering team through a period of significant growth or organizational change

• 
Have experience delivering AI-powered product capabilities.

What do we offer?

• 
"Once in a lifetime" growth opportunity in an aspiring unicorn business that will 5x over the coming 4-5 years backed by the Private Equity fund, Copilot Capital

• 
Great level of responsibility from day one in a dynamic and international environment

• 
A collaborative and thriving office-first culture where team spirit and fun are at the heart of everything we do 🙌🏽

• 
Access to cutting-edge technology and resources, enabling you to excel in your role and drive impactful change

• 
The chance to make a significant impact on the long-term strategic direction of our platform

• 
25 days of paid vacation per year

• 
Office and team in both Vilnius, Stockholm, London, Odense and Copenhagen

• 
Free coffee, tea, soda, or similar at the office

• 
Global Summer Party in Copenhagen with the whole organization

• 
Thriving Culture Club that plans Friday bars, running club, Tuesday fitness w. professional instructor, Wednesday bathing club, Summer parties, Christmas Parties and many other social events🌟

The hiring process

• 
Teams call with Talent Department.

• 
In-office or online interview and causal first talk with our CTO

• 
Online meeting with relevant internal stakeholders, Director of Product & Design, Engineering Team members etc.

• 
Official Interview and Technical Challenge with the CTO, Team members and Talent, online or in office.

• 
Final step is the Assessio Personality test, which all Relesys colleagues take, with the purpose of strengthening our cross-collaboration by becoming more aware of each person's unique strengths, communication style and where we make each other stronger!

• 
Follow-up conversation about our match – If successful, we are excited to welcome you to the team!

When and where do you start?

• 
We are looking for a colleague to start as soon as possible and not later than December 2026

• 
We are always looking for great Talents, so the starting date is flexible depending on when we find our right match

• 
Apply for the position by sending your CV through the Apply button

We can't wait to hear from you!

Who are we?

Relesys isn't just another SaaS company; we are a dynamic force revolutionizing communication and performance management platforms. Established in 2014, we set out on a mission to bridge the gap between HQ and non-desk workers, fostering a thriving workforce.

What value do we bring? People are the heartbeat of our client's business. When employees are thriving and successful, businesses flourish and retention rates increase. Relesys enables our clients to achieve this through an all-in-one app that streamlines communications, training, and daily operations into their own customized and ever-evolving app.

With clients such as Salling Group, COOP, Carlsberg, and Vestas - to name just a few - Relesys serves clients in 15 different countries, supporting them in 40 languages with +500,000 licenses across 20,000 stores and users in +100 countries. We have a strong presence in the Nordics and EMEA, and we continue to increasingly attract clients from across the globe, as we are breaking into new, dynamic markets.

At Relesys, we're shaping the future for frontline workers across various industries: Retail, Hospitality, Production/Manufacturing, and Transportation – while having FUN, as our rule number one! Join us on this thrilling journey as we grow and venture into new horizons.

Our Culture

Building a world-class organization and culture is our highest priority. We believe in the talent of our people and in long-term collaborations where we value an informal yet highly professional culture. We always go 'the extra mile' for our colleagues and clients, but rule number one - Have fun! This rule is always at the forefront of our minds when we come to work, creating an environment that is filled with passion, energy, and inspiration. We are eager to see what exciting contributions you, as our new colleague, will bring, as we believe that each and every individual has a tremendous influence on the whole 🌍

jobs.occupation: Tracking Microbes Across Borders using Genomics to Uncover Biomass-to-Biogas Transmission Pathways
jobs.employer_name: Technical Sciences - Institut for Husdyr- og Veter
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Animal and Veterinary Sciences programme. The position is available from 01 January 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title
Tracking Microbes Across Borders using Genomics to Uncover Biomass-to-Biogas Transmission Pathways

Research area and project description
Biogas production supports the transition to renewable energy and a circular bioeconomy. However, the increasing use of imported animal-derived biomass creates connected biosecurity interfaces between European suppliers, international transport, Danish reception points, biogas plants and nearby livestock production. This PhD project will determine whether these pathways are microbiologically plausible and identify where hygienisation and other biosecurity barriers interrupt them.

Using a risk-informed longitudinal design, the candidate will sample linked compartments including incoming biomass vehicles, reception and unloading areas, local vehicles and machinery, plant environments, biomass before and after hygienisation, and selected onward-facing interfaces. The project will combine targeted PCR/RT-qPCR surveillance for epidemiologically relevant transboundary animal-disease agents and other animal pathogens with long-read shotgun metagenomics, culture and viability approaches, and sequencing of selected isolates. Comparative genomic analyses will assess microbial connectivity between compartments while distinguishing co-detection from evidence consistent with persistence or transfer. Findings will be integrated with biomass origin and type, transport history, season and plant/process conditions.

Controlled experiments will quantify persistence, transfer and inactivation under representative transport, storage, cleaning/disinfection and processing conditions. Where work with high-consequence agents is not feasible, appropriate surrogates, indicators or non-infectious materials will be used. The project will deliver evidence on microbial hazards, resistomes, mobile genetic elements, critical control points and effective biosecurity barriers in the Danish biogas sector.

Qualifications and specific competences
Applicants to the PhD position must hold a relevant master’s degree, or an equivalent qualification, in Genomics, veterinary science, microbiology, molecular biology, bioinformatics, or a closely related discipline.

Relevant experience in molecular microbiology, microbial genomics/metagenomics, culture-based microbiology, bioinformatics or quantitative data analysis is an advantage; applicants are not expected to be experts in all areas.

The successful candidate should be motivated to combine field sampling, laboratory experiments and computational analysis; work carefully under appropriate biosafety and quality procedures; collaborate across institutions and with external stakeholders; and communicate effectively in written and spoken English. A driving license and willingness to travel to Danish biogas plants are advantages.

Place of employment and place of work
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is Aarhus University, Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, Blichers Allé 20, 8830 Tjele, Denmark.

Contacts
Applicants seeking further information regarding the PhD position are invited to contact:
 
• Yaovi Mahuton Gildas Hounmanou, gil@anivet.au.dk (main supervisor)
• Anders Dalsgaard, adal@sund.ku.dk (co-supervisor)
• Karl Pedersen, karl.pedersen@anivet.au.dk (co-supervisor)
For information about application requirements and mandatory attachments, please see our application guide. If answers cannot be found there, please contact:
• admission.gradschool.tech@au.dk
How to apply
Please follow this link to submit your application.

Application deadline is 01 November 2026 at 23:59 CET.
Preferred starting date is 01 January 2027.

For technical reasons, you must upload a project description. Please copy the project description above and upload it as a PDF in the application.

Please note:

• The programme committee may request further information or invite the applicant to attend an interview.
• Shortlisting will be used, which means that the evaluation committee only will evaluate the most relevant applications.
Formalities and salary range
Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions. You will be employed as an academic staff member at basic salary grades 4–8. As a PhD fellow you will also receive a monthly non-pensionable allowance.
Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which everyone has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

The application must be submitted via the online recruitment system, which can be accessed under ‘How to apply’.

jobs.occupation: Chief Commercial Officer
jobs.description:
About Memtrace

AI coding agents are fast, but they forget. They lose context between sessions, repeat mistakes, and don't understand the codebase around them. Memtrace builds the memory layer that fixes this: a deterministic knowledge graph of your code, built with AST parsing rather than guesswork, that any coding agent can use. Our products include MemDB, MemFleet, Cortex, and a code review engine. We are backed by Antler and Innovation Fund Denmark, and we work with Google, AWS, and Microsoft for Startups.

The role

You will own revenue end to end: strategy, pipeline, pricing, partnerships, and the first commercial team. We have developer interest and active pilots with enterprise customers. Your job is to turn that into repeatable, paying adoption. At this stage you will do the selling yourself while building the playbook that others will follow.

What you will do

• 
Define and run the go-to-market motion: developers adopt, engineering leaders and budget-holders buy.

• 
Own the revenue number and the pipeline. Run discovery, demos, pilots, and negotiations personally.

• 
Convert pilots into contracts, with clear success criteria, pricing, and procurement paths.

• 
Set pricing and packaging for individual, team, and enterprise tiers.

• 
Build channel and ecosystem partnerships (cloud marketplaces, consultancies, industry bodies, AI-coding-tool vendors).

• 
Feed customer and market insight back to product and research, and help decide what we build next.

• 
Hire and lead the first commercial team (sales, solutions, customer success) when the time is right.

• 
Report on pipeline, conversion, and retention to the founders and investors.

What we are looking for

• 
8+ years in B2B software sales or commercial leadership, with at least one role in developer tools, data/AI infrastructure, or open-source-led products.

• 
A track record of closing enterprise deals yourself, ideally in the Nordics or wider Europe.

• 
Experience selling to both technical champions and executive buyers, and knowing how those conversations differ.

• 
Comfort with ambiguity: you have built a sales motion without an existing playbook, brand, or team.

• 
Enough technical depth to talk credibly with engineers about codebases, CI/CD, and AI agents.

• 
Strong written and spoken English; Danish or another Nordic language is a plus.

Nice to have

• 
Experience with PLG, usage-based pricing, or open-core models.

• 
Existing relationships with engineering leaders at Nordic enterprises.

•

jobs.occupation: Associate Professor (non-tenured) in archaeometry at SDU in Odense
jobs.description:
A position as non-tenured Associate Professor in archaeometry is available from 1 May 2027 until 31 March 2030 at the Department of Physics Chemistry and Pharmacy, Faculty of Science, SDU in Odense.

About the research group and the project
The research group at which this position is posted is called CHART (Cultural Heritage and Archaeometric Research Team). Cultural Heritage and archaeometric research deal with investigations of samples originating from all sorts of culturally important artefacts: those procured by archaeologists in excavations, medieval buildings, handmade artefacts of all kinds, pieces of art, written materials. Only, the objects must have survived and be preserved today to some tangible degree. The study of cultural heritage is not exclusively for the humanities. In the last four or five decades, natural sciences have been increasingly involved in untangling the events of the past by studying cultural heritage objects to an ever-increasing degree of complexity. 

 

In CHART we take up the challenge of investigating cultural heritage objects on an international level using chemistry and physics. We aim at making a difference on the international scene by inventing new analytical methodologies, investigating objects of national and international interest, and by always securing collaboration between natural science and the humanities.

We do not claim to produce final or stand-alone answers; instead, we strive to achieve solutions together with colleagues from the humanities. In our research laboratories we daily cross the line between natural science and the humanities.

 

The present position is aimed at executing the already financed CIPP Center (Center for the Interior of Parchment and Paper), which involves the investigation of the Dead Sea Scrolls (https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/fakulteterne/naturvidenskab/nyheder-2026/erc-dead-sea-scrolls-archaeometry), the development of new methods for analysing paper and parchment, and a new project on poisonous books conducted in collaboration with the Royal Academy in Copenhagen, Pisa University, and the Library at SDU (https://www.nature.com/articles/s40494-019-0334-2 ).   

 

About the candidate
The successful candidate is expected to hold a PhD in archaeometry, analytical chemistry, or a closely related field, with a research profile centred on the application of analytical and physical-chemical methods to archaeological and heritage materials. A demonstrated expertise in a wide range of archaeomaterials (e.g., ceramics, bricks, pigments, and parchments) spanning diverse chrono-cultural contexts will be considered an asset. 

 

Tasks

• 
The candidate must partake in the execution of the research at the CIPP Center conducted by the CHART research group and contribute to the overall research theme of CHART. 

• 
The candidate must be able to support the ongoing collaboration with ADBOU at the SDU Health Faculty.

• 
The candidate is expected to obtain external funding for independent research, to foster internal collaboration at the Department, and to build and lead an internationally recognized research group. 

• 
The candidate should contribute to public outreach and communication activities.

• 
The candidate should teach (broadly) in degree programmes at the department, as well as participate in departmental administration, strategy development and educational programme development. 

• 
The candidate is expected to mentor undergraduate, graduate, and research students. 

 

Skills

• 
The candidate must have a strong and independent research profile, documented by an excellent track record of peer-reviewed publications in international journals. Hands-on experience with advanced analytical chemical instrumentation, experience with luminescence-based dating methods, and a demonstrated ability to develop or adapt analytical chemical methods will be highly valued.

• 
Experience with international collaboration, of partnerships with museums and cultural-heritage institutions, and of collaboration with the private sector will be an advantage.

• 
The successful candidate should have a strong teaching record. This includes experience with teaching courses within a chemistry curriculum at bachelor and master level as well as experience of project supervision across all levels, from bachelor to PhD. Experience with interdisciplinary, practical, and laboratory-based teaching, and with modern teaching methods, e-learning, flipped classroom, and online learning methods will be an advantage. A teaching CV should be included in the proposal. Teaching at the department includes first year teaching held in Danish, and the successful applicant may be expected to be involved in first year teaching. However, teaching in English is accepted from the start of employment, and the successful applicant is expected to learn basic Danish within 5 years. The university offers language courses.

The candidate will be part of the chemistry section. 

Application deadline: 15. November 2026 at 23:59 hours local Danish time

Please see the full call, including how to apply, on www.sdu.dk

jobs.occupation: Postdoc in shrub expansion and ecosystem responses in Subarctic tundra
jobs.description:
A 2-year postdoctoral fellowship is available from 16 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter in the Terrestrial Ecology Section within the Department of Biology at the University of Copenhagen.

  The position is available in a project assessing the role of shrubs as drivers of ecosystem changes in the Subarctic. In this project, we conduct field and laboratory analyses in order to get a better understanding of the role of low shrubs in vegetation changes, nitrogen cycling and carbon sequestration in subarctic ecosystems. The host research group focuses on Plant Physiological Ecology & Biogeochemistry and it is led by Professor Anders Michelsen at University of Copenhagen. The work includes field visit(s) to long-term experimental sites near Abisko in Northern Sweden, and collaboration with Associate Research Prof. Matteo Campioli at University of Antwerpen.

  Project overview

  The project is aimed at studying plant responses to long-term experimental warming in Subarctic tundra heath ecosystems, including biomass changes and warming impacts on plant nitrogen uptake as well as primary and secondary growth.

  Subarctic heaths are one of the ecosystem types most affected by the ongoing climatic changes, showing large biotic changes such as shrubification. Both evergreen and deciduous shrubs are expanding and will likely dominate future dry heaths in subarctic Scandinavia. Shrubs have an important role as ecosystem engineers, linked to shrub dominance patterns and performance. We will reveal 1) evergreen and deciduous shrub biomass and nitrogen (N) pool responses in subarctic tundra ecosystems influenced by experimental summer warming for one, two or three decades; 2) primary and secondary growth by dominant shrubs in the same control and warmed plots, and 3) the shrub N uptake in spring and summer in these experiments using an isotope labelled amino acid. The aim is to improve our fundamental understanding of shrub expansion, interactions with soil processes and significance for climate feedbacks in a future warmer Subarctic. The experimental setup is unique in terms of time span and potential for comparing responses at multiple time points at the same site, and at multiple sites with similar vegetation, on a decadal time scale.

  The project relies on established long-term field experiments in Abisko, Northern Sweden. The project combines field-based sampling of plants and soil, analysis of plant trait responses, labelling with stable isotopes, biogeochemical analyses including assessment of soil nutrient availability, microbial biomass and soil carbon stocks, and with analyses of carbon and nitrogen isotopic composition and plant primary and secondary growth as additional tools.

  Main tasks and responsibilities

  The successful candidate will be responsible for developing independent research within the scientific area of the project, in close collaboration with host and the external partner. This includes data and sample collection in field experiments, extensive processing of previously obtained biological material and data, interpretation as well as writing scientific publications. Note that much of the field sampling has already been performed. The candidate should be willing to perform additional field work in subarctic N. Sweden (Abisko) alone and with host and collaborators (short period(s) for up to 3 weeks in total in spring/summer), with research visit at University of Antwerpen, and extensive laboratory work (assisted by PI and lab technician) in Copenhagen where the post doc is based.

  Qualifications

  We are looking for an ambitious, creative, and highly motivated candidate with a PhD in plant ecology, biology, biogeochemistry, or a related field. Solid experiences with field and lab-based experimental work, and data analysis/statistics are expected. Fluency in written and spoken English is a requirement, as well as excellent writing skills demonstrated by the publication record. A successful candidate also has some experience with analyses of plant traits, ecosystem responses and/or biogeochemical responses to environmental changes, and interest in the use of stable isotopes in ecology. Although the candidate must be able to work independently, good interpersonal skills are also needed.

  Procedures and shortlisting

  After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Appointments Committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether an expert committee will assess their application. Selected applicants are notified of the composition of the committee, and the time schedule of an interview (around end of November). Each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself. The Head of Department, based on the recommendations of the assessment committee, will make the final selection of the successful candidate.

  You can read about the recruitment process at https://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

  Place of employment and principal place of work
 University of Copenhagen, Department of Biology, Terrestrial Ecology Section, Universitetsparken 15, DK-2100 Copenhagen.

  Terms of employment
 The position is from 16 January 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. Employment period is 2 years.

  Salary, pension and other conditions of employment are set in accordance with the Agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant organisation. Depending on qualifications, a supplement may be negotiated.

  The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

  Further information can be obtained from Prof. Anders Michelsen (e-mail: andersm@bio.ku.dk).

  How to apply
 The application, in English, must be submitted electronically by clicking APPLY FOR POSITION below.

  Please Include:

   	
• A cover letter including (i) statement of research interests, (ii) reasons for applying to this position and (iii) few selected concrete proposals/ideas for possible novel and relevant research work within the topics of the project (max. 2 pages) 	
• Curriculum vitae including a list of publications 	
• Copy of the PhD diploma or documentation for planned PhD defense 	
• Separate reprints uploads of 3 particularly relevant papers, and upload or link to PhD thesis 	
• Max. 2 letters of reference   Deadline for application is 1 November 2026 at 23:59 GMT +1. Applications received after the deadline, not using the online application form, or not including the required documents will not be considered.

  The University of Copenhagen wishes to reflect the diversity of society and welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

jobs.occupation: Tanker Broker
jobs.description:
Driving commercial growth across global markets

**As our new Tanker Broker, you will play an important role in developing and strengthening Uni-Tankers’ commercial position within the chemical and product tanker markets. Drawing on your market knowledge, industry network, and commercial mindset, you will identify new opportunities, build close relationships, and contribute to the effective operation of our fleet.

You will be based at our headquarters in Middelfart and work closely with colleagues across Chartering, Operations, and other business functions. Travel to customers, business partners, and industry events will be a natural part of the role.

In addition, your responsibilities will be:

• Develop and maintain relationships with customers, brokers, and business partners

• Identify and secure profitable cargoes and vessel opportunities

• Optimize schedules and trading patterns

• Negotiate charter parties and commercial terms

• Monitor market developments and identify new business opportunities

• Expand Uni-Tankers’ commercial network and customer portfolio

**Your Profile

**We are looking for a commercially driven shipping professional who thrives in an international environment and enjoys creating value through strong relationships and market insight. You are curious and motivated by identifying opportunities and turning them into results, and you naturally build working relationships with colleagues, customers, and business partners alike.

We imagine that you bring 5-10 years of chartering experience within the chemical or product tanker market and have built a well-established network within the international shipping industry. You combine commercial instinct with a structured approach and are comfortable navigating complex negotiations and market dynamics.

Additionally, you:

• Possess an established network within the international shipping industry

• Demonstrate business acumen and negotiation skills

• Communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing. Danish language skills are preferred

• Have solid IT skills

**What We Offer

**Uni-Tankers is committed to empowering employees and promoting their professional growth. As our new Tanker Broker, you will enjoy:

• A key commercial role with significant impact on business development and performance

• Close collaboration with experienced colleagues across the organization

• An international working environment with broad industry exposure

We are a family-owned company with a solid culture, and we support and help each other. Our core values are Decency, Leadership & Business Acumen.

**Uni-Tankers

**Uni-Tankers is a leading tanker shipping company in the intermediate and small tanker segment. The fleet is one of the youngest in its core markets, comprising approximately 45 owned and chartered modern and flexible product and chemical tankers.

Uni-Tankers was founded in 1995 as a subsidiary of the Danish, family-owned United Shipping & Trading Company (USTC). The shipowning company has offices in Denmark, Turkey, France, Singapore, and the US.
